title: HeartBEAM: Older Adult Resting State and Auditory Oddball Task EEG Data
description: This dataset comprises resting state and auditory oddball task electroencephalography (EEG) recordings from older adults under two experimental conditions: control and threat-of-shock arousal. Participants completed eyes-open and eyes-closed resting periods, as well as passive and active auditory oddball tasks in both conditions. The data supports investigation of locus coeruleus-noradrenaline system function and attention-related neural dynamics in aging.
methods_description: EEG data were collected during resting state (eyes open and closed, 5 minutes each) and auditory oddball tasks (passive and active variants) under control and threat-of-shock conditions. The auditory oddball paradigm included standard tones, target tones, and distractor tones, with active task variants requiring manual button responses.
